# Instagram Profile Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/instagram-profile-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-profile-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.652**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape all Instagram profile info. Just add Instagram usernames, IDs or URLs and extract name, join date, number of followers,  location, bio, website, related profiles, video&post count, latest posts. Export scraped data, schedule scraper via API, and integrate with other tools or AI workflows.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Profile $0.0026, Add-on: About account $0.007 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-profile-scraper) for current prices.

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-instagram-profile-scraper@0.0.652#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      usernames: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `usernames` | array | yes |  | Instagram username(s) — Provide one or several Instagram user names you want to scrape the posts from. The actor will also handle user name IDs. |
| `includeAboutSection` | boolean |  | `false` | $ Extract about account information — This feature is for paying users only. If enabled, the scraper will extract information about the account, including date joined, country of origin, and the profile's channel information. It also fills an empty `businessAddress` when the about source has it. Ple |
